title: 第4章 下山第5章 遇险第6章 偶遇
content_zh:
灵台脉贯通后，许星遥正式踏入尘胎境中期，这也意味着他终于可以申请下山历练。
按照太始道宗的规矩，弟子踏入尘胎境中期后，可前往百艺阁选择一门辅修技艺。
百艺阁分为炼器、炼丹、灵植、阵法、符箓、测算等诸多体系，每门技艺又分七阶，对应不同境界的修士需求。
许星遥站在百艺阁前，仰望着这座古朴的九层楼阁。
每一层檐角都悬挂着不同颜色的风铃，最顶层青玉风铃在晨风中发出清越的声响，仿佛在召唤着他。
新晋中期弟子？一位鹤发童颜的老者坐在青玉案前，手中蒲扇轻摇，想修习哪门技艺？
许星遥恭敬行礼，粗布衣袖沾着未干的泥土：弟子想学灵植之术。
老者眼中闪过一丝诧异，仔细打量这个衣着朴素的少年。
如今弟子多选炼器炼丹，肯学灵植的倒是少见。
他从案下取出一枚翠绿玉简：灵植阁在第七层，持此简可直接进入。
踏入灵植阁，许星遥顿时被满室清香包围。
四壁藤蔓缠绕，开着各色灵花，中央九排檀木架上整齐摆放着玉简竹帛。
最引人注目的是东南角的灵土圃，里面栽种着数十种正在生长的示范灵植。
他轻抚过书架上的标签：农徒入门灵苗培育心蕊嫁接...最终停在《灵植本源》前。
这部典籍用青丝编成，翻开时散发出松针般的清香。
灵植之道，首重天时地利。
一株灵苗，三分靠种，七分靠养。
开篇写道。
许星遥合上《灵植本源》，指节轻轻叩击书封，往后翻阅几页，典籍上却明确写着：灵植之道，木灵为尊。
他低头看了看掌心萦绕的寒气，这是墨雪湖四年苦修留下的印记，与灵植所需的温和木灵格格不入。

不适合又如何。
他轻声自语，将典籍内容一丝不苟地录入玉简。
既然选择了这条路，便没有回头之理。
走出百艺阁时，夕阳将他的影子拉得很长。
路过炼器阁的朱红大门，许星遥脚步微顿，灵台脉既成，是时候考虑本命法器了。
回到湖畔茅屋，他取出粗布包袱。
一柄短锄、数个空玉匣、十二块下品灵石，七张一阶尘明符级别的符箓，数十颗一阶尘芽种级别的冰棘种，这就是他全部的家当。
许星遥盘算着：下山一趟不易，不如同时解决灵种与炼材两件事。
他指尖轻点玉牌，背面画像中的少年正弯腰在灵田劳作。
许星遥嘴角微扬，将包袱系紧。
翌日清晨，许星遥来到执事堂，申请下山历练。
执事堂内，一位中年修士正在整理卷宗，见他进来，淡淡问道：姓名？境界？下山缘由？
墨雪湖弟子许星遥，尘胎境四脉，申请下山寻找炼器材料。
许星遥恭敬回答。
中年修士抬眼看了他一眼，似笑非笑：寒门弟子？
许星遥点点头。
下山令牌需缴纳十点贡献值，你可有？
许星遥从怀中取出身份玉牌，递了过去。
这上面记录着他四年来积攒的贡献点，平日除了修炼，他还在灵田劳作、采集灵药、完成宗门任务，才勉强攒下这些。
中年修士接过玉牌，随手一划，扣除十点贡献值，随后取出一枚青铜令牌递给他：下山期限三月，不得逾期。

许星遥接过令牌，郑重收好。
许星遥刚迈出执事堂的门槛，便与匆匆赶来的林澈迎面相遇。
这位向来从容的世家子弟此刻眉宇间凝着一丝罕见的焦灼，锦缎衣袖上还沾着未干的晨露。
许星遥正要开口询问，不想林澈却先开了口。
content_en:
After the Lingtai vein was connected, Xu Xingyao officially entered the middle stage of the mortal realm, which also meant that he could finally apply to go down the mountain to experience.
According to the rules of Taishi Dao Sect, after disciples enter the middle stage of the mortal realm, they can go to Baiyi Pavilion to choose a minor skill.
Baiyi Pavilion is divided into many systems such as weapon refining, alchemy, spiritual planting, formations, talismans, calculations, etc. Each skill is divided into seven levels, corresponding to the needs of monks in different realms.
Xu Xingyao stood in front of Baiyi Pavilion, looking up at this simple nine-story pavilion.
Wind chimes of different colors hang from the eaves of each floor. The topmost sapphire wind chime makes a clear sound in the morning breeze, as if calling him.
A new mid-level disciple? An old man with white hair and a boyish face is sitting in front of the sapphire table, waving the cattail leaf fan in his hand. Which skill does he want to practice?
Xu Xingyao saluted respectfully, his coarse cloth sleeves stained with wet soil: The disciple wants to learn the art of spiritual planting.
A trace of surprise flashed in the old man's eyes, and he looked carefully at the plainly dressed young man.
Nowadays, most disciples choose to refine weapons and elixirs, but few are willing to learn spiritual cultivation.
He took out an emerald jade slip from under the case: Lingzhi Pavilion is on the seventh floor. You can enter directly with this slip.
Stepping into Lingzhi Pavilion, Xu Xingyao was immediately surrounded by the fragrance that filled the room.
The four walls are twined with vines and blooming with various spiritual flowers. In the center, nine rows of sandalwood shelves are neatly arranged with jade slips and bamboos.
The most eye-catching thing is the spiritual soil garden in the southeast corner, where dozens of growing demonstration spiritual plants are planted.
He lightly touched the label on the bookshelf: Peasant Beginner's Guide to Cultivating Spiritual Seedlings and Grafting Heart Cores... Finally, he stopped in front of "The Origin of Spiritual Plants".
This classic book is made of blue silk and exudes a fragrance like pine needles when opened.
The most important thing in the way of spiritual cultivation is the right time and place.
A spiritual seedling depends on three-thirds of its growth and seventy-ones of its cultivation.
The opening paragraph reads.
Xu Xingyao closed "The Origin of Spiritual Planting", tapped the cover of the book lightly with his knuckles, and flipped through a few pages. It was clearly written in the book: In the way of spiritual plantation, the wood spirit is respected.
He looked down at the cold air lingering in his palms. This was the mark left by four years of hard training in Moxue Lake, and it was incompatible with the gentle wood spirit needed for spiritual cultivation.
So what if it doesn't fit.
He whispered to himself and meticulously entered the contents of the classics into the jade slips.
Now that you have chosen this path, there is no turning back.
When he walked out of Baiyi Pavilion, the setting sun stretched his shadow very long.
Passing by the vermilion gate of the Artifact Refining Pavilion, Xu Xingyao paused slightly. The Lingtai Vein was complete, and it was time to consider the natal magic weapon.
Returning to the lakeside hut, he took out his coarse cloth bundle.
A short hoe, several empty jade boxes, twelve low-grade spiritual stones, seven first-order Chenming Talisman-level talismans, and dozens of first-order Dust Bud Seed-level Ice Thorn Seeds, these were all his possessions.
Xu Xingyao thought: It is not easy to go down the mountain, so it is better to solve the two problems of spiritual seeds and refining materials at the same time.
He tapped the jade medal with his fingertips, and the young man in the portrait on the back was bending over and working in the spiritual field.
Xu Xingyao raised the corner of his mouth slightly and tied the baggage tightly.
Early the next morning, Xu Xingyao came to the Deacon Hall and applied to go down the mountain for training.
In the deacon hall, a middle-aged monk was sorting out the files. When he saw him coming in, he asked lightly: What's your name? realm? Reason for going down the mountain?
Xu Xingyao, a disciple of Moxue Lake, a member of the fourth lineage of the Chen Fei Realm, applied to go down the mountain to find materials for refining weapons.
Xu Xingyao answered respectfully.
The middle-aged monk raised his eyes and glanced at him, half-smiling but not smiling: A disciple from a poor family?
Xu Xingyao nodded.
You need to pay ten contribution points to go down the mountain. Do you have it?
Xu Xingyao took out the identity jade token from his arms and handed it over.
It records the contribution points he has accumulated over the past four years. In addition to practicing, he also works in spiritual fields, collects elixirs, and completes sect tasks, so he can barely save these.
The middle-aged monk took the jade token, swiped it casually, deducted ten contribution points, and then took out a bronze token and handed it to him: The time limit for going down the mountain is three months, and it cannot be overdue.
Xu Xingyao took the token and put it away solemnly.
As soon as Xu Xingyao stepped out of the threshold of the Deacon Hall, he met Lin Che who was rushing over.
This young man from an aristocratic family who has always been calm has a trace of concentration on his brows at this moment.Rarely anxious, the brocade sleeves were still stained with wet morning dew.
Xu Xingyao was about to ask, but Lin Che spoke first.
